additional_info.subject: ID0386866-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / N8 160373407] Charger shutdown CRM:00797001367
additional_info.body:
Hello Simen Aare
,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Kople AS
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / N8 160373407
Charger ID/Serial No.:
0x3JyV
Problem Description:
Charger offline, charger have shutdown due to overheat.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since
7th August 2023
,
as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Upon reviewing the logs, we found that the charger shut down due to the internal EVSE temperature exceeding the upper limit, and the PLC error flag 'PT1000_BT5_AC-Income' changed to true.
This may be due to an issue may be related to BT5. Please refer to the KA link below for troubleshooting:
KA Link:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_BT5_MainFanGQ1_XD9.2B - Dynamics 365
We also recommend carrying a spare PT1000 temperature sensor while visiting the site, in case a replacement is needed.
Spare Parts details:
8EM5903-0AA00-1AA3 -BT3, -BT4, -BT5 Temperature Sensor PT1000 M8 5m
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sominath Nagalgaon
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
